name: Keystone: Autophagosomes and Endolysosomes 2025

name: Gordon Research Conference: Lysosomal Diseases 2027
venue: Les Diablerets Conference Center / Eurotel Victoria
desc: GRC on Lysosomal Diseases, themed "Understanding Lysosomes to Enable Innovative Therapies". Five-day closed meeting on unpublished work spanning fundamental lysosomal biology and therapy development for lysosomal storage disorders. Preceded by the associated Gordon Research Seminar (15-16 May 2027). Application deadline 18 April 2027.
mtor: TIER 3 — Indirect but real: the lysosomal surface is the platform on which mTORC1 is activated (Rag GTPases, Ragulator/LAMTOR, v-ATPase), and mTORC1 in turn controls the TFEB/TFE3 lysosomal-biogenesis program. Lysosomal-storage-disease biology and mTORC1-TFEB signalling are studied by overlapping groups (e.g. Ballabio, Zoncu, Ferguson, Settembre). Scope note: this is a lysosome-biology meeting, not an mTOR-centred one — mTOR content will be a subset of the program. Tier is provisional: the programme is unpublished as of 2026-08-15 (due 19 August 2026), so relevance is currently inferred from the community rather than from stated sessions; revisit for a possible TIER 2 once sessions are announced.
organizers: Chairs and vice-chairs not yet published by GRC as of 2026-08-15; preliminary program with invited speakers due 19 August 2026.

name: ASCO Annual Meeting 2027
desc: The largest clinical oncology meeting worldwide; where practice-changing trial results are first presented.

name: American Transplant Congress (ATC) 2027
desc: Joint annual meeting of the American Society of Transplantation (AST) and the American Society of Transplant Surgeons (ASTS); >4,000 attendees. (ATC 2026, Boston, 20-24 June 2026, has already passed.)
mtor: TIER 2 — Transplantation is the largest human exposure dataset in existence for sirolimus and everolimus (approved for rejection prophylaxis long before any geroscience trial) and the origin of the canonical adverse-effect profile the Atlas records: hyperlipidaemia, insulin resistance and new-onset diabetes, impaired wound healing, mucositis, infection. Supplies the human safety denominator that geroscience trials cite second-hand. Atlas authors in this space: Budde K, Saemann MD, Singer LG.

name: AACR-NCI-EORTC International Conference on Molecular Targets and Cancer Therapeutics 2027
desc: Small, drug-development-focused conference jointly organised by AACR, the NCI and the EORTC; the main venue where first-in-human data on novel targeted agents are reported before journal publication.
mtor: TIER 2 — Direct provenance for the Atlas's own Schram 2025 entry: the first-in-human phase 1/1b data for RMC-5552, the first bi-steric mTORC1-selective inhibitor in the clinic, were presented here (Abstract C020, 2023) before the Clinical Cancer Research paper. This is where Open Question 2 (inhibit mTORC1 without affecting mTORC2) is being answered in humans rather than in mice: bi-steric selectivity relieves the mTORC2-mediated hyperglycaemia that limited earlier pan-mTOR inhibitors. Also the venue for 4E-BP1 pharmacodynamics and mucositis management.
organizers: AACR, NCI, EORTC
